cars.verdict: Clean car, full price. Two owners, Audi-serviced every year, no repairs and no accidents reported. The ask sits above both 2017 V10 Plus sales on BaT: $172,500 at 14k miles and $151,000 at 24k. Zach held firm on price Oct 28 and adds $1,500 shipping. A PPI still comes first: CARFAX shows only what shops report.

rev.good: Reviews praise Zach Hashmi for buying cars and shipping out of state.
rev.bad: Yelp 2.0 from 56 reviews; DealerRater reviews are mixed on follow-up and add-ons. Cars.com not read.
